channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Former lifeguard writes novel to ‘solve’ 1964 Ocean Beach murders
item.description: Those killings were attributed to the infamous Zodiac Killer, who taunted police, was never apprehended, and who went silent six years later.

item.title: Pipeline project continues at Mission Trails Regional Park
item.description: Construction on new water infrastructure is moving full steam ahead at Mission Trails Regional Park, part of the county's AWP program.

item.title: Art exhibit of ‘Heroes’ at Liberty Station celebrates Navy’s 250th birthday
item.description: Pisano’s installation is part of efforts celebrating the country and the Navy’s 250th birthday by the Liberty Station Community Association.

item.title: Opinion: California’s resilient community colleges are built for what comes next
item.description: California community colleges like MiraCosta are succeeding in helping students complete college and move into meaningful careers and continued education.

item.title: Newsom expanded free preschool. Now private day cares can’t afford to stay open
item.description: The California governor tripled early childhood funding and expanded TK to all 4-year-olds. But preschools are closing, making infant care harder to find.

item.title: California sues over Trump’s $600 million in cuts to public health funding in four states
item.description: Cuts are being made to the Public Health Infrastructure Grant in four blue states, even though the program funds health departments in all 50 U.S. states.

item.title: Expansion team no more, SDFC enters 2026 campaign with far higher expectations
item.description: "We have our mindset that we will have to compete at the highest level," said SDFC midfielder Aníbal Godoy.

item.title: Storms soak San Diego County, with more rain and snow through Thursday
item.description: A parade of winter storms brought widespread rain, gusty winds and mountain snow to San Diego County this week, with a third round of unsettled weather expected through Thursday.

item.title: ‘It feels a little weird’: Buehler signs with Padres after long career with rival Dodgers
item.description: Walker Buehler has signed with the San Diego Padres after the right-hander spent the first eight seasons of his major league career with their archrivals, the Los Angeles Dodgers.

item.title: Chula Vista woman with alleged ties to Sinaloa Cartel sentenced to prison
item.description: A Chula Vista woman who prosecutors say held a leadership role in a drug trafficking organization with ties to the Sinaloa Cartel was sentenced Tuesday to 11 years and three months in prison.
